g.text: Each dot is one comparison. Diamonds show the middle result (median).
119/120 paired comparisons verified. Row counts: no Minimap / released Minimap.
Both trips must pass to form a pair; failures stay in the full trial data and pass counts.
Setup and the separate destination checker are excluded from these times.
The full speed-and-correctness goal has not passed. These are descriptive comparisons.
